name: HoldExpired
doc: Business payload only (ADR-IC-002); the CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. The hold timed out before capture (ADR-PC-033): it leaves the active set, restoring the available balance, with NO posting — no money moved. Appended by an operator/command action reading the projection-derived expiry horizon, never by a clock-driven scheduler (ADR-PC-023). DORMANT wire shape (the .avsc.json posture): the event is STORE-ONLY today (ADR-IC-017 — no named external consumer); bus promotion is renaming to .avsc plus the AsyncAPI catalog entry and shape-lock. Field names follow the engine codec convention. No PII (ADR-PC-004).

fields.name: instance_id
fields.doc: The account-owning instance (stream) the hold rides — a structural id, not PII.

fields.name: hold_id
fields.doc: The placed hold this expiry releases (the ADR-PC-033 slot-4 lifecycle key).

fields.name: account_ref
fields.doc: The opaque account whose available balance the release restores — a reference, never PII.

fields.name: value_date
fields.doc: The economic date the expiry took effect — an input from the expiry read, never a clock read.
